teamHomePage.heading: Momentos, <highlight>authentic stories</highlight>
teamHomePage.paragraph1: <highlight>Momentos</highlight> was born from the passion of turning moments into <highlight>memories</highlight> that span <highlight>generations</highlight>.
teamHomePage.paragraph2: Photography has always been part of our story; first as a hobby, then as a form of language and communication through the capture of <highlight>emotions</highlight>, immortalising what often goes unnoticed…
teamHomePage.paragraph3: Offering a <highlight>sensitive</highlight>, <highlight>artistic</highlight> and <highlight>professional</highlight> eye on important moments was the conviction that led to the creation of Momentos.
teamHomePage.objective2: Ensure technical and aesthetic <highlight>quality</highlight> in every project;
teamHomePage.objective3: Provide a <highlight>personalised</highlight> service tailored to each client's needs;
teamHomePage.objective4: Build lasting relationships based on <highlight>trust</highlight>, <highlight>professionalism</highlight> and <highlight>creativity</highlight>.
